UPSTREAM: Make Ada a first class citizen Some remarks on the make process: o We usually leave Ada specs (.ads files which are like c headers) together with the bodies (implementations in .adb files) in one directory. So we have to know, where they live. o If there is no matching .adb an .ads is a valid source file and we'll generate an object file from it. o Object files need to have the same basename as their source files :-/ That's why we put them in build/<class>/ dirs now. o We track dependencies by looking at the compiler output (.ali files which accompany every .o). This way we don't need any gnatmake magic, or even more complex, less portable tools. For ADAFLAGS_common, I simply copied the CFLAGS_common whilst dropping everything unsupported and adding sane warning options. The set of language features is highly restricted (see gnat.adc). This should suit the embedded nature of coreboot and helps proving absence of runtime errors with SPARK. it83xx: EC sleep mode for system hibernate The typical power consumption in sleep mode is 65uA. IT83xx uses deep doze mode for low power idle task. The typical power consumption in this state is 280uA (depends on EC tasks, it should be more) and the wake up time is in microsecond. We are using deep doze mode for low power idle task instead of sleep mode is because the wake up time will be 6ms more. While in system hibernate (EC sleep mode), EC won't wake up frequently so we can keep the power consumption at 65uA. wpa_supplicant: mesh: check kernel STA entry before adding In some cases, mesh beacons / probe resps may get queued up in the supplicant event queue. If supplicant processes back to back new peer candidate messages from the same peer, it may add the same peer to kernel multiple times. This creates a number of issues, including slow authentiction due to reiniting the state machine each time supplicant gets a new peer event. This CL checks, when supplicant already has a STA entry, if kernel also has the corresponding entry. If yes, then drop the new peer event and return. Also adding more logging information around mesh authentication and mpm processes. BUG=b:31555246 TEST=manually on 2 gales. Run child groobe test for 100 times and see the change triggers 43 times on root and 1 time on child. Observe 1 groobe test run containing Confirm mismatch message (it could still happen but not due to duplicate new peer events).
